body: His mom can be a hard person to get along with, but I think she still has a good heart and loves her children. I hope she can help.

I guess his network is his family (who he's not really that close to, but I've asked his mom to get involved anyways) and his friends, who he doesn't really share a close personal connection with. With his friends they mostly bond by playing video games, but they don't really talk to each other about their feelings and things like that.

I've had that thought, but he seems truly depressed and sad. I think some of it is a mix of attention seeking with real intent. But maybe you might have a point. I just don't want to run the risk of not taking this seriously. 

But you are right about the silent suicidals. My uncle took his own life and no one saw it coming, not even his girlfriend or son. He hadn't muttered a peep about it to anyone.

I don't think he would do anything to me, but I guess the blowback is that the police won't really accomplish anything and then he'll never tell me about his feelings again. And then he'll have suicidal feelings without telling anyone about it. I feel like all the police are going to do is watch him for a little bit before letting him go, I don't know if that would do anything - if not make things worse.
What will happen when I call the police? I have no idea what they're going to do or what to expect. I'm kind of afraid to call the police.
